summary: Decide sooner that a seat needs no login item, and read the person steps through the assignee index

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild, and no claim is projected differently. Which seats raise a login item and which person steps raise an attention item are unchanged.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers. The login probe reads claims_harness_login_candidate_index and the person-step read uses step_runs_assignee_index, both of which already exist.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. The Now and Attention reads return the same items, only sooner. One edge: a step assignee spelled with an upper-case Person/ prefix, which the daemon never writes, is no longer matched as a person.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover: the change only decides sooner that a seat has no login evidence, and swaps a case-insensitive LIKE for an index range. A seat that does have login evidence takes the same path as before.
